_comment: All experiment parameters for the MVP run. Change values here, never inside the code.

selection._max_side_overrides_comment: room maps are all 512x512, so none pass 256; allowed up to 512 (runtime to be checked in Prompt 2)

sim._max_steps_comment: max_steps = factor * opt_len + extra. Main run (5760 runs): factor 10 (raised from 4 after the smoke run, where saboteur detours on room maps reached 6-7x the optimum).
sim._capped_rerun_comment: 52 main-run runs (all saboteur, all room maps) still hit 10x opt + 100. They were re-run by scripts/rerun_capped.py with factor 30 and merged into runs.csv by scripts/merge_capped_reruns.py; the re-runs matched the originals exactly except steps, success and timings.
sim._path_max_len_comment: Not read from here: src/sim.py asks D* Lite for current_path(max_len=10000) (PATH_MAX_LEN). The port keeps the game's default of 2000. Longest path measured: 1999 cells.
